links.outcome: Consensus alignment and completeness of LLM answers to AMD patient questions, rated by ophthalmologists
links.effect: ChatGPT4 scored 5 from both reviewers on 88.72% for C1 (consensus) and 91.73% for C6 (missing content); PaLM2 on 60.90% and 69.92%.
links.quote: Out of 133 questions, ChatGPT4 received a score of five from both reviewers to 118 questions (88.72%) for C1, to 130 (97.74%) for C2, to 131 (98.50%) for C3, to 133 (100%) for C4, to 132 (99.25%) for C5, and to 122 (91.73%) for C6, while PaLM2 to 81 questions (60.90%) for C1, to 114 (85.71%) for C2, to 115 (86.47%) for C3, to 124 (93.23%) for C4, to 113 (84.97%) for C5, and to 93 (69.92%) for C6.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance (accuracy, harm, consensus) on patient questions regarding age-related macular degeneration using expert ophthalmologist grading, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
